The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Apple Pies can be made in [[Cooking Pot]]s by combining [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Cane Sugar]], [[Goat Butter]], and an [[Apple]]. Their flaky pie crusts and sweet Apples are thought by many people throughout [[Hyrule]] to be a match made in heaven. [[Misa's Recipe Book]] at the [[Slippery Falcon]] in [[Rito Village]] contains a recipe for Apple Pie. [[Misa]] first suggests buying Tabantha Wheat, Goat Butter, and Cane Sugar from the Slippery Falcon.{{Cite|First, you'll want to buy {{Color BotW|Blue|Tabantha wheat}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|goat butter}}, and {{Color BotW|Blue|cane sugar}} here at the {{Color BotW|Blue|Slippery Falcon}}.|Misa's Recipe Book|BotW}} She then tells the reader to cook them with an Apple until the crust is a flaky golden brown and the insides are gooey.{{Cite|Cooke those ingredients with an {{Color BotW|Blue|apple}} until the crust is flaky golden brown and the insides are gooey and delicious.|Misa's Recipe Book|BotW}} Finally, she tells the reader they can substitute the Apple with another [[Ingredient]] for an added kick.{{Cite|And for an added kick, try substituting the apple with something else!|Misa's Recipe Book|BotW}} Apple Pies made with the base recipe sell for 30 [[Rupee]]s. However, they can sell for up to 70 Rupees depending on the additional Ingredient added. Eating a basic Apple Pie will restore three of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. They will restore four Hearts if an additional Apple is added, or five Hearts if another Tabantha Wheat is added. A fifth Ingredient can be added to Apple Pie, which will result in it having different effects: * '''Chilly Apple Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Apple Pie}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Inventory|BotW}} They can be eaten to temporarily increase Link's [[Heat Resistance]] by one level. They also restore four of Link's Hearts and can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Electro Apple Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Apple Pie}}
Grants mid-level electricity resistance.
The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one will grant Link [[Shock Resistance]] for a short period of time. They also restore four of Link's Hearts and can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Enduring Apple Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Apple Pie}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one will completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. They also restore eight of Link's Hearts and can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Energizing Apple Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Apple Pie}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one will refill a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel. They also restore seven of Link's Hearts and can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Hasty Apple Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Apple Pie}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Inventory|BotW}} They will grant Link a speed boost when they are eaten. They also restore four of Link's Hearts and can be sold for 70 Rupees. * '''Hearty Apple Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Apple Pie}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Inventory|BotW}} They can be eaten to temporarily increase Link's maximum Hearts. They also fully restore all of Link's Hearts and sell for 60 Rupees. * '''Mighty Apple Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Apple Pie}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Inventory|BotW}} When eaten, they will grant Link a small boost to his attack-power. They also restore five of Link's Hearts and can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Spicy Apple Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Apple Pie}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one will increase Link's [[Cold Resistance]] by one level. They also restore three of Link's Hearts and can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Sneaky Apple Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Apple Pie}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one will increase Link's [[Stealth]]. They also restore four of Link's Hearts and can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Tough Apple Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Apple Pie}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The crispy, flaky pie crust and sweet apples are a match made in heaven.|Inventory|BotW}} If they are eaten, they will temporarily boost Link's [[Defense]]. They also restore four of Link's Hearts and can be sold for 50 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Apple Pie returns in {{TotK}}, where it has a similar [[Recipe]] to the one it had in {{BotW}}, which involves [[Cooking]] either an [[Apple]] or a [[Golden Apple]] alongside [[Cane Sugar]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Tabantha Wheat]] in a [[Cooking Pot]] or [[Portable Pot]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Desserts, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Pies |items= BotW, TotK }}
